learning_question: Among soft-vetoed (WARN+) sealed N200 names that later became large winners under sealed baseline fair-cost, how often would frozen MONITOR rule R1 (breakout-wait; R5=40d / R6=−15%) have re-admitted before opportunity expired — vs never (timeout / worsen)? Companion: path-cost Δ vs sealed baseline on recovered names; abandon rate on WARN+ deep losers. Observe labels only — no live gate.
